answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 582 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. The oasis index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The fee repeats 16 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
